search_scope: Targeted primary-source verification, corrections/version search and local-code applicability audit. Not a systematic review.

records.version_consulted: University of Kent Author's Accepted Manuscript, 12 PDF leaves including repository cover; source locations refer to those leaves.
records.read_coverage: Entire accessible accepted-manuscript content, including repository cover and all sections/references. Plot explanation read; published confidence-interval equation visually checked on PDF leaf 10.
records.equation_visual_check: Leaf 10 rendered and inspected: Eq. (5) is a mean-ratio Fieller interval, not the campaign median bootstrap.

queries: Rigorous Benchmarking in Reasonable Time corrections errata extended version
corrections_and_new_versions.result: No dedicated erratum found in consulted records. ISMM paper cites fuller Kent TR 4–12. arXiv:2007.10899v1 was deposited 21 July 2020, displays November 2013 manuscript date, and has one listed version. It is a related fuller report, not a 2020 new benchmark experiment. Report metadata inspected; its full proofs were not audited here.

records.version_consulted: Ten-page author-hosted short conference paper; this omits proofs and predates the expanded 1997 journal version.
records.read_coverage: Full ten-page short paper using layout and raw extraction. Relevant numerical forms in section 5.1 visually checked on PDF leaf 6 because text extraction loses mathematical symbols.
records.equation_visual_check: Leaf 6 rendered and inspected: determinants (1)–(4); no coefficients/error bounds applied to the wake test.

corrections_and_new_versions.result: Author identifies expanded 1997 Discrete & Computational Geometry 18:305–363 version, also CMU-CS-96-140. Author warns that extended-precision internal registers need suitable rounding configuration. No separate erratum located. Long-version metadata, not all long-version proofs, inspected; no claim to have audited those proofs.

excluded_as_authorities: Search snippets and secondary indexes were discovery aids; paper content and bibliographic decisions rely on listed author/institution/publisher sources.
Goldberg, Verlet, Allen/Tildesley and other discovered literature were not adopted without a matching verified reading; not included as phantom references.
cache_handling: sources/ is local reading cache only. Exclude all PDFs, extracted text, and rendered pages from publication or distribution unless independently authorized.
